description: This file defines a generic record `PagedResponse<T>` used as a minimal page-like response wrapper in API endpoints, providing content and pagination metadata, with JSON serialization customizations.

classes.name: PagedResponse
classes.description: A generic record that encapsulates a paginated response with content and metadata, designed for API client consumption.

methods.name: categories
methods.description: Returns the content list, aliased as 'categories' for compatibility with certain clients.

methods.name: numberOfElements
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the content list, or 0 if content is null.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Indicates if the response contains no elements.
